summary: DMD of 100 snapshots of the limit cycle of the cubic cavity at Re = 1950. The modes lie on the harmonics of the cycle, 1 to 6 times 2 pi / T, and none grows.
description: The stage reads 100 snapshots of 000_dns, one every 0.5 time units from t = 1740 to 1789.5, about 4.6 periods of the cycle, and computes 20 DMD modes. A flow on a limit cycle of period T has the frequencies n 2 pi / T and a growth rate of zero. plot.py takes, for n = 1 to 6, the mode with the positive frequency nearest to n 2 pi / T (T = 10.78909, the period of 000_dns_period). The reference checks the frequency of each of these six modes against n 2 pi / T, the growth rate of the fundamental, the largest modulus of the eigenvalues, and the energy of each of the four leading singular values of the snapshot matrix. A wrong snapshot spacing, window or period moves the frequencies off the harmonics. The values are those of the run named under produced.

max_abs_mu.note: Largest modulus of the 20 eigenvalues of the map over one snapshot interval. A value above 1 is a growing mode; the snapshots lie on the cycle, so none grows.

harmonic_1_ratio.note: Angular frequency of the mode nearest to the fundamental, over 2 pi / T.

sigma_fundamental.note: Growth rate of the fundamental, in units of U/L. It is zero on a cycle; the fit over 4.6 periods leaves -3.8e-4.

svd_mode1_energy_percent.note: Energy of the first singular value of the snapshot matrix; the first two singular values form the pair of the fundamental.

svd_mode2_energy_percent.note: Energy of the second singular value. The first two together hold 94.26 %.

svd_mode3_energy_percent.note: Third singular value, the first of the pair at twice the frequency.

svd_mode4_energy_percent.note: The first four singular values hold 99.60 %.
